name: Fixture 3: unbraced rectangle
note: do not modify without human approval
description: Issue W1-01. Four edge members form a 2 by 1 rectangle in the XY plane with rigid joints and the two bottom corners fixed. The load is 1000 N in global +X at node 3 (2, 1, 0). The brace block adds the diagonal from node 1 (0, 0, 0) to node 3 (2, 1, 0) for the braced comparison, which must cut the loaded-node translation by at least minimumRelativeStiffening. Positions are solver lengths in meters, and tests use scale factor 1. Section values are fixture-local, not game constants.
